Binance Altcoin Netflow
HOT, GRT, LINK, FET and AXS are seeing excessive outflows on Binance. DODO, YGG and CRV appear close to the threshold.

Strong inflows are visible in GTC, YFI and CHZ. MASK, AGLD and BTC appear close to the threshold.
ETH is seeing slight outflows, while BTC is seeing moderate inflows.

Outflows are concentrated mostly in AI and infrastructure/DeFi tokens, while inflows are showing up in low-liquidity coins. This suggests capital is pulling quality altcoins off the exchange.
For altcoins seeing outflows, the shrinking supply on Binance indicates that selling has slowed. However, reduced selling pressure alone is not a trigger for a rally in the short term.

For altcoins flowing into Binance, the growing supply puts them in a position ready to be sold and can increase selling pressure.
If outflows continue over the next few days, that would support the case for a rally in these altcoins. Coins seeing inflows, on the other hand, would enter a rally under heavier pressure and rise less.
